If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 and price is rising, cap forecast increase at 2.0% for early horizon.  
If sentiment drops to 0.00 and price is falling, add 1.0–2.0% upward bias for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is negative (e.g., -0.33) and forecast is above true, reduce by 1.0–1.5% for late horizon.
